Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Title = the X value (date, category). One row per series, same order as the legend.
Values in uz-UZ format: 12 400 · 4,8 mln · +12,4%. True minus sign −.
Max 6 rows; the rest becomes “Other”.
Never cover the point being read — place above, flip below at the top edge.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
Field
Definition
Purpose
Value read-out on hover or tap. Raised surface (layer 3) with Elevation/2.
Encoding
title ← x · row.marker ← series.color · row.label ← series.label · row.value ← formatted y
Interaction
Appears on hover (Web, 0 ms delay) or tap (touch); Esc closes; arrow keys move between points when the chart has focus.
Accessibility
role="tooltip"; the same values are announced via aria-live on keyboard focus; never the only way to read a value — table view exists.
